scope: private macOS cache-hit worker and lightweight C client; not production adoption
checks: miss falls back; worker hit preserves every artifact and diagnostic byte
source mutation causes normal compiler miss
per-request environment changes invalidate and previous environment restores correctly
per-request cwd isolation and original cwd reuse
artifact blob corruption recompiled and repaired
already-dirty live mmap source mutation is detected by full hashing
unsupported invocation preserves compiler failure status and diagnostics
fallback compiler receives original stdin and produces identical executable
stable Zig 0.17.0 executable restored by worker with identical bytes
concurrent same-key restores preserve outputs and locks
terminated workers and leftover sockets fall back to accepted wrapper
